name: Scarred Legion [Teamwork]
body:
Your ritual scars make you more fearsome, and allies with similar scars grow bolder when they’re near you.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Intimidate checks. You also grant a +2 morale bonus on Will saving throws to adjacent allies. When you charge, if your allies were adjacent to you at the start of the charge, they retain the bonus on Will saves until the start of your next turn.
